text_block_list.text:
October ★ | Post-Race | Wind: Swirling 
Gale "Our Golden Route" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant 1st-place finish in the 
Kikuka-sho! Yes! We pulled it off without 
a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Gaining time at every corner— 
Navigator-dono's strategy paid off 
brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We are the strongest! Victory is ours 
thanks to the Navigator's strategy and my 
execution!
